before: An Agy init event and terminal result with different explicit conversation_id values were parsed as terminal_success=true and complete=true. The runner marked the artifacts ready and the observer accepted the matching forged summary.
The first fix still accepted an unknown Agy event with a contradictory or malformed envelope conversation_id between matching init and result events.

after.explicit_id_checks: Compare every present nonblank conversation_id on known event envelopes and payloads; inspect the envelope even for an unknown or malformed event type.
after.unknown_event_behavior: Unknown Agy event types fail closed with a line-numbered terminal error.
after.contradiction_behavior: A changed or malformed explicit ID makes terminal_success and complete false; the observer rederives this from archived JSONL bytes.
after.absent_id_behavior: Valid historical streams without IDs remain parseable and report local_identity_unverified.
after.privacy: Only a sanitized consistency state and error location are retained in the summary or observer output, never the raw conversation ID.

verification.independent_review: Initial adversarial review reproduced the unknown-event bypass; follow-up review reproduced rejection for same, different, numeric and absent IDs on unknown events and an invalid event type, with no remaining finding in scope.

limits: A matching ID is consistency of local JSONL only, not provider, model, effort, usage or billing authentication.
An ID absent from a valid historical trace remains unverified, not equivalent to matching IDs.
No new Agy provider run or confirmatory N/SDD/toolkit comparison was performed.
